سُكَاكَةٌ Small in the ear, (M, K,) or in the ears. (IAar, TA.) [See also أَسَكُّ.] ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) One who is alone in his opinion, having none to share with him in it, (AZ, K, TA,) who acts without caring how his opinion happens to be: pl. سُكَاكَاتٌ: it has no broken pl. (AZ, TA.) ＝
-A2- See also سُكَاكٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
